thread:
Elsa: quick note — during partner onboarding we hit two surprising error cases that show our SDK parity gaps: 1) a 422 validation from the model runtime vs a proxied 200 with an error body; 2) rate-limit surfaced as HTML from CDN. Both confuse sampleapp and retries.

Ravi: can you paste the raw responses?

Elsa: sure. Case A (422): server returns 422 with JSON {code: 'validation_error', message: 'prompt too long', fields: ['prompt']}. python SDK surfaces ValidationError with structured fields. JS client, behind a proxy, gets 200 with body "{\"error\":\"validation_error\",\"message\":\"prompt too long\"}" but the CDN wrapped it into an HTML page in prod so fetch returns text/html and we just throw generic Error('unexpected content-type').

June: ugh. So JS fails before the normalization layer. That explains support tickets. We need the network layer to try to parse JSON bodies even when content-type is wrong and fall back to the envelope.

Pat: Case B (rate-limit): origin returns 429 + Retry-After. CDN sometimes emits a 200 HTML page (maintenance banner) and the SDK treats it as success. Our retry middleware doesn't see 429 so no backoff.

sdk-bot: created issue #8001 "sdk: resilience for proxied non-JSON error payloads + validation parity" — https://github.com/redwood/infra/issues/8001

Ravi: proposal: SDK normalization steps should be: 1) if status >=400 and body is JSON -> use envelope; 2) if status >=400 and content-type != json -> attempt JSON parse anyway; 3) if status==200 but body contains top-level error keys (code/message/error) -> treat as application error (map to code enum) but mark as proxied_error; 4) fall back to unknown_error. Also include header sniffing: x-rw-error-code.

Elsa: agree. Also want clearer split between validation_error (client fixable) and transient_transport (retryable). validation_error -> non-retryable, include fields[] with hints; proxied error -> preserve original http_status in envelope.original_status so SREs can triage.

June: UX note for sampleapp: show validation errors inline with form fields using fields[] and human_action like 'shorten prompt to 2048 chars'. For proxied errors show friendly banner 'Service temporarily unavailable' with error_id and a small 'More details' dev panel. Do not leak raw HTML.

Pat: tests: create a CDN-proxy harness that returns 200 with HTML but JSON body inside, and ensure JS SDK still extracts code. Add e2e for Retry-After header preserved through proxies. Add integration test that ValidationError serializes fields to the UI.

Ravi: SDK changes checklist:
- JS: network layer tolerant JSON parse, RedwoodError has original_status, proxied flag, and fields array. Normalizer that detects body-error keys even on 200.
- Python: ensure ValidationError includes fields[] and human_action; keep behavior but add original_status when proxied.
- Sampleapp: show field-level validation messages, collapse dev view for proxied errors, never render HTML.
- Telemetry: emit code, error_id, original_status (if proxied), contract_version, but strip any HTML.

Elsa: small compatibility note: keep Error.message for one release. Add deprecation warning in logs if downstream code parses message text.

sdk-bot: assigned GH #8001 to @Ravi and @June. ETA: small PRs this week.

June: I'll take sampleapp UI and python patch. Ravi you good to own JS network normalizer?

Ravi: yep, taking JS. I'll also add a small README snippet on how proxies can break error semantics and a recommended nginx config for forwarding status codes.

Pat: thanks — this should reduce onboarding noise a lot. :thumbsup:
